```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a hna
  have := h (s ∪ {a}) (by simp [hna])
  rw [insert_eq_union, singleton_subset_iff] at this
  exact this
· intro h'
  intros s t hs ht
  induction s with a s' using Finset.induction_with_insert
  · refine le_refl _
  · rcases hs with ⟨a, ha, hsa⟩
    obtain ⟨ha', hsa'⟩ := hsa
    have := h' (s' ∪ {a}) (by simp [ha'])
    rw [insert_eq_union, singleton_subset_iff] at this
    exact this
```
